title: Carry MidiMsg through the MIDI pipeline and strip javax.sound.midi from tuner
body:
Part of #278 (sub-issue 3 of 5). Depends on sub-issues 1 and 2.

- `MidiSplitter(transmitter: MidiTransmitter) extends MidiReceiver`: fans out to `transmitter.receivers`.
- `MidiProcessor`: `receiver: MidiReceiver`; `transmitter: MidiProcessorTransmitter` extending `ConcurrentMidiTransmitter`, whose `receivers_=` calls `onDisconnect()` before and `onConnect()` after a change of the receiver set; `process(message: MidiMsg, timeStamp): Seq[MidiMsg]`.
- `MidiSerialProcessor` wires with `receivers = Seq(next.receiver)` / `clearReceivers()`; constructor takes `initialOutputReceivers: Seq[MidiReceiver]`.
- `PitchBendSensitivityMessages.create` returns `Seq[MidiMsg]`; `mapShortMessageChannel` deleted.
- `MidiDeviceHandle` converts at the boundary: outbound `asJava` in its receiver (a `Midi2Msg` is dropped with a warning), inbound `asScala` into a `MidiSplitter(ConcurrentMidiTransmitter())`. `MultiTransmitter` deleted.
- `tuner`: `Tuner`, `TuningChanger`, `TunerProcessor`, `TuningChangeProcessor`, `MpeTuner`, `MonophonicPitchBendTuner`, `MtsTuner`, `PedalTuningChanger` use `MidiMsg` and drop `asScala` / `asJava`; `MtsMessageGenerator` uses `SysExMidiMsg.StatusByte` / `EndOfExclusiveByte`; `Track` drops its output splitter and exposes `receiver: MidiReceiver` and the pipeline's `transmitter`; `TrackManager` follows; tests stub `MidiReceiver`.
- After this, `tuner` has no `javax.sound.midi` import.
